Institute for Development & Research in Banking Technology
(Estd. By Reserve Bank of India)
Advertisement No: 08 /2026 – 27 Date: September 01, 2026
Rolling Advertisement for Research Trainee
IDRBT - The Institute (https://www.idrbt.ac.in/about-idrbt/):
The Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology (IDRBT),
established by the Reserve Bank of India, is a premier Institute for adoption and absorption
of Banking Technology. The Institute spearheads efforts in providing state-of-the-art Digital
Public Infrastructure and Product Development for public good through applied Research,
Executive Education, Consultancy, etc. so as to continuously enable the technology
transformation. Please see the genesis and journey on link above.
Opportunity for Skill Development
The prospective candidate will have opportunities to learn on the job and also can hone
their functional skills and expertise in various areas of specialization. The Institute offers a
variety of EDPs for Banking and non-banking sector executives. It has six Research Centres
for various emerging technologies and labs, provides a platform to Ph.D. students for
conducting research on niche technologies and their applications in industry. These
experiences provide an unbeatable platform to build and augment the career. These
experiences provide an unbeatable platform to build and augment the career because of the
sheer variety of work being done at IDRBT.
Position: Research Trainee
IDRBT invites applications from recent B.Tech. graduates to join as Research
Trainees. The selected candidates will work closely with technical teams on ongoing projects
in areas such as Banking Technology, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics,
Digital Payments, Cloud Computing, and related domains.
i. Eligibility:
A. Educational Background:
• B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence
& Machine Learning, Data Science, Electronics & Communication, Cyber Security,
or related disciplines.
• Candidates should have completed their degree in Academic Year 2024-25 or
later.
• Minimum 70% marks or 7.0 CGPA in the qualifying degree.
Page 2 of 2
B. Desired skills
• Programming knowledge in Python, Java, or equivalent.
• Understanding of software development, databases, AI/ML, cyber security, cloud
computing, or data analytics.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to learn new technologies and work collaboratively in a team environment.
C. Key Responsibilities
• Support the execution of ongoing technology and innovation projects at IDRBT.
• Assist in software development, testing, deployment, and maintenance activities.
• Participate in the design, development, and evaluation of prototypes and
technology solutions.
• Collaborate with project teams to meet deliverables and timelines.
• Prepare technical presentations, progress updates, and project reports.
• Support workshops, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing activities related to
project outcomes.
D. Stipend
• As per Institute norms
Rules and Regulations
1. Candidates who completed their B.Tech./B.E. prior to Academic Year 2024-25 are not
eligible to apply.
2. All the above positions are purely on contract basis.
3. There will not be any regularization for the candidates on boarded by the Institute through
this web notice. A separate advertisement/web notice will be published for regular
appointment in IDRBT.
4. The preliminary assessment for candidature and suitability will be on the strength of the
information submitted in the Application form.
5. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria would be called for participation in the selection
process which may involve online/in-person interaction.
6. In all matters regarding the appointment process, the decision of the Institute shall be
final. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected
at any stage even after the issue of Offer letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify /
withdraw / cancel any communication made to the candidates.
7. Interested candidates may submit their application through the link provided on the
Careers page of the Institute’s website, along with an updated CV, a recent photograph,
a valid identification document (such as an Aadhaar Card), and a cover letter highlighting
their suitability for the position. Alternatively, candidates may apply by ☛ clicking here.
8. Queries if any may be sent pragati@idrbt.ac.in.
9. This is a Rolling Advertisement, and though candidates may apply at any time;
applications received shall be processed on a monthly basis.
